title: Orbit-resolved spectra and dynamical accessibility in multi-register covering Hamiltonians

creators.name: Luiz, Fabrício de Souza
creators.affiliation: Instituto de Física Gleb Wataghin, Universidade Estadual de Campinas

description:
Reproducibility artifact for the associated theory manuscript on orbit-resolved spectra and dynamical accessibility in multi-register covering Hamiltonians. The release contains the manuscript source and PDF, frozen and hashed Set Cover instances, exact and residual-aware numerical audits, generated tables, and the code required to reproduce them.

The artifact has scope-specific open licenses: original software in code/ is MIT; original manuscript material, documentation, generated results, and project-authored data are CC BY 4.0; redistributed OR-Library material retains J. E. Beasley's MIT notice; and the official quantumarticle.cls and quantum.bst package files retain LPPL 1.3c. See the top-level LICENSE and LICENSES/ for the controlling notices.
notes: No quantum-speedup, NISQ-feasibility, or total hardware-resource claim is made. Finite numerical results are diagnostics; the asymptotic claim rests on the analytic theorem in the associated preprint.
